quote: “Eat cream and mustard seed,” she says with urgency. Jealousy and lies. “Drink sack…” Mockery. “Black pudding, garlic.” Revenge, miserliness. “Pork snout, duck tongue, roast pigeon.” Smuggling, usury, thieving. She knows all the foods. “Eat a lamb’s heart.” Killing a babe.
author: Megan Campisi
